slides.text: Ethiopia Insider reports a **Tigray party** says its chairman was held in **federal custody**; a hearing is set for **Monday**, with **no official comment**.
The **FAO** says local **maize prices** rose **70 to 90 percent** from **Dec 2025 to Sep 2026**, reaching record highs.
The **WHO** says a **polio vaccination** campaign runs **Nov 21-24** in **five regions**, targeting **11.3 million children**.
